messages:
Zoe: Quick totally-scientific poll — which LLM would you take on a coffee date? (reasons mandatory) :eyes:
Alex: I'm voting for gpt-5-lite — it orders a single oat milk latte and doesn't derail into sonnets. :coffee:
Morgan: Team minerva-7b for deep mysterious vibes. Also it ghosted after 3 tokens once so it's low-maintenance. :sob:
Jin: codex-cuddle. Finishes my code *and* my bad poetry. Sends helpful inline diffs. @Tara?
Tara: Redwood-serve-2 — shows up on time, reliable, has great healthchecks. low-key married to its monitoring dashboard. :heart:
Sam: Important follow-up: would you trust your chosen LLM to look after a potted plant? :seedling:
Zoe: only if it has a `water-schedule` skill and can read humidity sensors, otherwise no. :sweat_smile:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout to prod-llm-pods completed — no dramatic anthropomorphizing detected. :tada:
Morgan: Prompt joke of the night: prompt: `be less cryptic` -> model: "Sorry, how cryptic would you like me to be? Please define units." :laughing:
Alex: petition to add an "Anthropomorphize" section to release notes. e.g. "v2.3: sharper personality, less existential dread."
Tara: we need a new emoji for "model sad about quantization." ideas? :crying_cat_face:
Sam: poll time — best LLM anthropomorphism: 1) Overly dramatic bard 2) Sarcastic code reviewer 3) Sleepy assistant 4) Overly polite consultant. pick two.
Zoe: votes: 2 & 4. Someone make a sticker pack pls.
Alex: also tldr: treat your models like coworkers, not roommates. keep snacks away from the GPUs. :potato:
